FeatureSection derived its empty-state icon filename from the selected section, so opening the media library requested image://lucide/media/<tint>, which is not bundled. It now maps only the sections it draws (status, calls, channels, communities, profile) and requests nothing otherwise. Verified with an isolated fake-RPC fixture at /tmp/whatsappgo-nav-icons.KfXqnN: 6 provider failures before, 10 checks with zero failures in each of light and dark after, a killed mutation restoring the old filename, 44/44 CTest, go test and go vet. No commit; change is in the local worktree.

message.send, message.send_media, message.send_contact, message.forward and sticker.send now validate their destination with the new model.ValidateSendTarget: only person (@s.whatsapp.net, @lid) and group (@g.us) addresses are accepted, and the status broadcast refusal names status.post. Replying to a status still works because only chat_jid is validated, not reply_chat_jid. Tests in internal/model/target_test.go and internal/service/send_target_test.go; a mutation restoring the old empty check fails them.

A refused notification is re-emitted as notification.received with handled=0, so the window presents it through the tray instead of the message disappearing. Applied to the incoming-message path, status alerts and deliverAlert. Test TestAFailedAlertAsksTheWindowToPresentItInstead; a mutation removing the fallback fails it. Remaining limit, recorded in SECURITY.md: without a system tray there is no second chance.

GetCapabilities now records body-markup as well as sound, and Desktop.presentedBody escapes & < > in the body for servers that advertise it. Summaries and the portal path are left as plain text per the specification. Tests TestBodyIsEscapedOnlyForServersThatParseMarkup and TestEscapingLeavesOrdinaryMessagesAlone; a mutation that skips escaping fails them.

claimAlert evicts its oldest entry when the table is full instead of refusing new alerts, so status volume cannot silence calls or security-code alerts. Bound is unchanged at 256 entries. Tests TestAFullAlertTableStillLetsACallThrough and TestTheOldestAlertIsTheOneEvicted; a mutation restoring the refusal fails them.

loadStarredMessages keeps the loaded list while refreshing (only a scope change clears it) and star events go through scheduleStarredRefresh, which answers the first star at once and folds the rest of a burst into one read per second. Measured with /tmp/whatsappgo-starred.2xxPw7: ten events 320 ms apart were 10 requests and 10 blanks before, now 5 requests and 0 blanks; at 40 ms apart, 2 requests. A mutation restoring the unconditional clear fails the fixture.

ExportChat takes a replace flag: without it the destination is created with O_EXCL, so an existing file is kept and the call fails with a clear message; with it the file is truncated as before. chat.export exposes the flag as optional 'replace' (default false) and the desktop passes true because its native save dialog has already asked. Gateway interface, Unavailable stub, api.go discovery entry and docs/API.md updated. Tests TestExportRefusesToReplaceAFileUnlessAsked and TestExportWritesANewFileWithOwnerOnlyPermissions; a mutation restoring O_TRUNC fails them.
